description: Source code for a module that converts PyTorch computational graphs into TensorBoard GraphDef protobuf format, including classes for representing nodes and graphs, and functions for parsing and tracing models.

classes.name: NodeBase
classes.description: Base class representing a node in the computational graph, with attributes like debugName, inputs, scope, tensor_size, kind, and attributes.

classes.name: NodePy
classes.description: Class representing a node in the graph, extending NodeBase, with methods to initialize from a C++ node object and extract relevant attributes.

classes.name: NodePyIO
classes.description: Subclass of NodePy representing input/output nodes, with additional handling for tensor sizes and kind.

classes.name: NodePyOP
classes.description: Subclass of NodePy representing operation nodes, extracting operation-specific attributes.

classes.name: GraphPy
classes.description: Helper class to convert a PyTorch model into a graph representation suitable for TensorBoard, including methods to append nodes, process scope names, and convert to protobuf format.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a PyTorch graph and trace to produce a list of nodes and stats for TensorBoard.

methods.name: graph
methods.description: Processes a PyTorch model and produces a GraphDef protobuf for TensorBoard visualization.

methods.name: _set_model_to_eval
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily set a model to evaluation mode.

methods.name: _node_get
methods.description: Retrieves attributes from a torch._C.Node object, handling polymorphic return types.
